name: llm-router-context-compact
description: Client-side context compaction for Copilot. Gives the agent a tool to report gateway context usage and compact the conversation natively, so the chat never re-sends bloated history.

languageModelTools.name: llm-router_contextUsage
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reports the current context usage (prompt tokens, % of window used) for the active chat session as observed by the LLM Router gateway. Call this at the start of a task or when the conversation is long, to decide whether compaction is needed.

model.description: The router virtual model name (e.g. the pool's virtualModelName) to query. Omit to use the gateway's default/latest.

languageModelTools.name: llm-router_compactConversation
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Compact the current conversation (client-side) to reduce context size. Replaces the older chat history with a concise summary so the next request doesn't re-send bloated history. Use this when context usage is high (e.g. >60% of the window) or the conversation has become very long.

reason.description: Optional reason for compacting, for the user's awareness.

llmRouter.gatewayBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the LLM Router gateway.

llmRouter.gatewayKey.description: Gateway key (Bearer token). Use a pool key + set defaultModel, or the unified gateway key.

llmRouter.defaultModel.description: Default virtual model name to probe when the caller does not supply one (e.g. a pool's virtualModelName).
